q.songTitle: I Need You to Tell Me Who I Am
q.line: Boxes full of dust are falling from the attic
stanza: I'm staring at the sky with a lump inside my throat
I'm as green as the grass in every song you wrote
Well babe, I'm afraid I lost it all before you knew I had it
Boxes full of dust are falling from the attic
I threw my love into the ocean and I found it in the sand
And I need you to tell me who I am

partner.line: I threw my love into the ocean and I found it in the sand

q.line: I can say that I'm ecstatic
stanza: You ask me, am I happy?
I can say that I'm ecstatic
'Cause we all just made a pact
When you're moving in the positive
Your destination is the brightest star
